card.name: The word in before case or event
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a phrase about having care, treatment or a backup ready, where "in case of" or "in the event of" comes next. Also fires on "the" in "in the event of".

modes.label: in case of
modes.description: "in" after medical management, attention or a replacement, leading into "case of" a complication.
modes.example: appropriate medical management<< in>> case of respiratory depression and/or prolonged sed

modes.label: in the event of
modes.description: "the" after "in" when the phrase continues as "in the event of" a reaction.
modes.example: appropriate medical treatment in<< the>> event of serious POME reactions or an

card.plain: It marks the spot where a label says something is kept on hand "in case of" a problem.
